details: Hopes for a US-Iran peace deal that initially boosted risk assets and lowered oil prices have been reversed by renewed tensions and reported ceasefire violations in the Strait of Hormuz. This has led to a retreat in global equities and a rebound in oil prices, creating a risk-off environment. Bitcoin, after an initial rally fueled by short squeezes, has subsequently slipped below key levels.
title: Renewed US-Iran Tensions Reverse Market Optimism, Bitcoin Slips

details: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde has expressed strong skepticism regarding the necessity of stablecoins pegged to the euro, suggesting they could impede the ECB's functions and worsen financial instability. The ECB is advocating for shifting crypto-asset oversight to a centralized EU authority, a move seen as tightening scrutiny on the crypto markets.
title: ECB Voices Skepticism on Euro Stablecoins, Pushes for Centralized EU Crypto Oversight

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has issued a warning that advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models could significantly amplify cyberattacks, potentially leading to "cascading failures" and systemic risks within the global financial system. The IMF urges policymakers to prepare for these inevitable cybersecurity vulnerabilities, which could disrupt financial intermediaries, payment systems, and market confidence.
title: IMF: AI Poses Systemic Cyberattack Risk to Global Financial Sector

details: The highly anticipated US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) data for April is scheduled for release today, May 8, 2026. Economists expect an increase of 62,000 jobs. A stronger-than-expected report, especially combined with rising oil prices, could heighten concerns about stagflation and potentially lead the Federal Reserve to maintain its current hawkish monetary policy, which typically impacts risk assets.
title: US Non-Farm Payrolls Expected Today, Critical for Fed Policy and Market Outlook

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase Global has reported its second consecutive quarterly loss. This is attributed to a significant decline in trading volumes, waning momentum in crypto prices, tighter financial conditions, and persistent macroeconomic uncertainty. In response to these challenging market conditions, Coinbase has also announced a reduction of approximately 14% of its global workforce.
title: Coinbase Posts Another Loss, Cuts Workforce Amid Soft Crypto Market
